test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man goes to Indore from Bhopal at a speed of 9 km/hr and returns to Bhopal at speed of 18 km/hr, through the same route. What is his average speed (in km/hr) of the entire journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the **distance** traveled is the same for both parts of the journey, use the harmonic mean formula.

**Average Speed** = (2 × s₁ × s₂) ÷ (s₁ + s₂)

Average Speed = (2 × 9 × 18) ÷ (9 + 18) = 324 ÷ 27 = 12 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 12 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Speed from **Bhopal** to **Indore** (v₁) = 9 km/hr, Speed from **Indore** to **Bhopal** (v₂) = 18 km/hr.

**Formula Used:** Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41a9c37114c6115330852affb1b57ca0d1e832644061a6c6260fb7e3aab7409d.png] 

⇒ Let the distance between **Bhopal** and **Indore** be 18 km (LCM of 9 and 18).

⇒ Time taken to go (t₁) = 18 ÷ 9 = 2 hours.

⇒ Time taken to return (t₂) = 18 ÷ 18 = 1 hour.

⇒ Total Distance = 18 + 18 = 36 km.

⇒ Total Time = 2 + 1 = 3 hours.

⇒ Average Speed = 36 ÷ 3 = 12 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Different Distances

If distances d₁, d₂ are covered with speeds v₁, v₂, then Average Speed = (d₁ + d₂) ÷ (d₁/v₁ + d₂/v₂).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the **opposite direction**, relative speed = s₁ + s₂. In **same direction**, relative speed = |s₁ − s₂|.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
